nodes.label: OptixOS System
nodes.rationale: High-performance retail Optical Point-of-Sale (POS) and Practice Management System.

nodes.label: Tier 1: Presentation Layer
nodes.rationale: Next.js 15 App Router client components with Zustand global state.

nodes.label: Tier 2: Business & Application Layer
nodes.rationale: Type-safe Server Actions acting as isolated domain controllers.

nodes.label: Tier 3: Data & Persistence Layer
nodes.rationale: PostgreSQL database accessed via Drizzle ORM with atomic row-level updates.

nodes.label: Decimal.js
nodes.rationale: Used for all monetary operations to avoid IEEE-754 floating-point errors.

nodes.label: Graphify Semantic Engine
nodes.rationale: Maintains an automated semantic knowledge graph synced with the codebase.
